step1_analysis.description: A differential delay cell with symmetric loads (diode-connected and biased NMOS in parallel) and a PMOS tail current source. This topology is typically used in ring oscillators for Phase-Locked Loops (PLLs) to achieve high power supply noise rejection (PSRR).

paper_reference.title: A Supply-Noise-Insensitive CMOS PLL With a Voltage Regulator Using DC–DC Capacitive Converter

dc_gain.description: Differential DC gain of the delay cell

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = Gm_diff / gm_load. With W/L_diff = 40, W/L_diode = 4, Gm ~ 379uS, gm_load ~ 243uS. Gain = 379/243 = 1.56 V/V = 3.8 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Delay cells need a gain slightly greater than 1 (0 dB) to sustain oscillation in a ring oscillator.

unity_gain_bandwidth.description: Frequency at which the differential gain drops to 0 dB

sky130_expected.calculation: UGBW = Gm_diff / (2 * pi * C_load). Assuming C_load ~ 20fF, UGBW = 379uS / (2 * pi * 20fF) ~ 3 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Must be high enough to support the 500-850 MHz oscillation frequency reported in the paper.

power_consumption.description: Static power consumption of the delay cell

sky130_expected.reasoning: A single delay cell consumes a small fraction of the total PLL power.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the diode-connected NMOS load. With 27.4uA and W/L=4, Vgs ~ 0.64V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Needs to match the input common mode for cascading multiple stages in a ring oscillator.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC gain, unity gain bandwidth, power consumption, and output common mode of the VCO delay cell.
step3_testbench.spice:
* VCO Delay Cell Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm7=10u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm2=20u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=20u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=2u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=2u L_xm13=0.5u

* DUT
XM7 N1 BP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM2 O1 VN N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 O2 VP N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM10 O1 BN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 O2 BN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 O1 O1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 O2 O2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VBP BP 0 1.0
VBN BN 0 0.5

* Input signals (Common mode = 0.64V, Diff AC = 1V)
VCM VCM 0 0.64
VAC_P VP VCM dc 0 ac 0.5
VAC_N VN VCM dc 0 ac -0.5

* Load capacitors to simulate next stage
CL1 O1 0 20f
CL2 O2 0 20f

.control
  * Operating Point Analysis
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  let vocm = (v(O1) + v(O2)) / 2
  print power
  print vocm

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1 10G
  let vdiff = v(O1) - v(O2)
  let gain_mag = mag(vdiff)
  let gain_db = 20 * log10(gain_mag)
  
  meas ac dc_gain_db find gain_db at=1k
  meas ac ugbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
  
  print dc_gain_db
  print ugbw
  quit
.endc
.end
